finalResult.nextParagraphText: “True, we did run off to the first universe, leaving everything in the hands of our subordinates,” the Sword Saint nodded with a smile. “Do you predict we’ll have to return when the universe begins to open up and allow lower-level C-grade visitors from the rest of the multiverse?”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “It’s certainly good that matter was handled,” the Sword Saint nodded. “Ell’Hakan was a threat we could do without, and with him gone, the galaxy is stable now. Well, as stable as one can expect a galaxy to be right after a war.”
